verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API reference documents a dedicated sandbox endpoint (https://api.sandbox.taxjar.com/v2/) separate from production, so the API can be tested without touching live data. Evidence is a single line in the reference docs, with no detail on how the sandbox behaves. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox credentials or API key provisioning, which endpoints the sandbox supports and its limitations, assurance that sandbox data stays isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
